summary: All 106 candidate source strings and current english-hold bindings match the paired drafts and English narration at current origin/main. All 65 mixed-body candidates compose exactly from the source field plus only their listed replacements. All 88 holds retain their exact source/current English-hold state. The three “read” candidates now keep read exact.
